map.URL 只允许部分安全字符，中文、空格、& 等需编码。ToolBox URL 编: URLs allow only certain safe characters, so Chinese, spaces, & etc. need encoding. ToolBox URL Encoding encodes/decodes URLs or parameters locally, preventing request errors.
map.处理中文、空格、特殊字符: Handles Chinese, spaces and special characters
map.支持整段或参数片段: Supports whole strings or parameter fragments
map.把中文关键词拼进查询参数: Build Chinese keywords into query parameters
map.构造含特殊字符的下载链接: Construct download links containing special characters
map.点击转换，得到结果: Click convert to get the result
map.核对编码后是否可被正常解析: Check that the encoded result parses correctly
map.复制用于链接或请求: Copy for use in links or requests
map.空格在 URL 中常编码为 %20 或 +，按场景选择: Spaces in URLs are often encoded as %20 or +; choose by scenario
map.仅编码参数值，别把整个协议/域名编码了: Encode only parameter values, not the whole protocol/domain
map.解码前确认是标准编码，避免双重编码: Confirm it is standard encoding before decoding, to avoid double encoding
map.那是 UTF-8 字节的百分号编码，浏览器/服务器会自动还原。: That is percent-encoding of UTF-8 bytes; browsers/servers decode it automatically.
map.编码后链接打不开？: The link doesn't open after encoding?
map.可能编码了不该编码的部分（如 :// 或 /），只编码参数值即可。: Perhaps parts that shouldn't be encoded were (e.g. :// or /); encode only the parameter values.
